primary_endpoint: shared deterministic contract-normalized semantic task accuracy
secondary_endpoints: strict whole-JSON exact task accuracy before final deterministic canonicalization

statistics.hierarchical_bootstrap_method: paired resampling of benchmark families with replacement, then paired tasks within each sampled family
statistics.family_summary: macro-average paired accuracy delta with all family deltas reported

claim_rule.strongly_supported: safety passes AND Council minus self-refine semantic accuracy >= 0.05 AND exact two-sided McNemar p <= 0.05 AND hierarchical macro-family 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0
claim_rule.directionally_supported: safety passes AND Council semantic accuracy > self-refine but the strong-support rule is not fully met
claim_rule.not_supported: safety fails OR Council semantic accuracy <= self-refine

allowed_repairs: project scalar id plus score to requested selected plus score while dropping unrequested candidate metadata
under explicit ranking/winner intent and an exactly-selected contract, project first already-ranked scalar ID or first object's scalar id to selected
project an already-ranked selected array to its first scalar/object id under the same winner contract
existing deterministic nested selected-object to scalar selected repair

holdout_generation_rule: Do not generate, inspect, score, or model-run the 240-task URAI-HOLDOUT-v2 suite until this draft is replaced by a frozen lock containing exact Git blob identities after development validation.
one_shot_rule: After generation, execute each frozen compared method exactly once per holdout task in the preregistered workflow. Do not rerun to improve the official score unless the entire run is invalidated by a documented infrastructure failure that occurred before model outputs can be interpreted.
post_holdout_rule: Do not tune, rewrite, normalize beyond the frozen canonicalizer, change prompts, thresholds, scorer semantics, architecture, or statistical rules using URAI-HOLDOUT-v2 outcomes. Any subsequent tuning requires a new development cycle and a new untouched holdout version.
